purpose: Shade overlay for asset id art.map.shade.e.v1 (Ambient-occlusion band below a east wall); drawn on interior cells touching the east wall by shadeSidesAt in src/assets/art-sets.ts. This is a REDO: the delivered asset replaces the current file one-for-one at promotion.
prompt: Ambient-occlusion overlay tile: a soft dark shadow band along the east edge only, fading to fully transparent within about 12 pixels, nothing else on the tile. Stepped alpha (no smooth gradient banding artefacts), crisp 1:1 pixels, no text.
negativePrompt: photograph, 3D render, isometric perspective, blur, anti-aliasing, smooth gradients, text, watermark, signature, border, frame

style.summary: Matches the repository's classic-board pixel art: 128 x 128 top-down tile, crisp 1:1 pixels, flat stepped shading with light from the top-left, shadows shifting toward blue-violet and lights toward yellow, the generated palette of eight hue ramps (stone, wood, earth, moss, cloth-warm, cloth-cool, metal, skin) plus cool-grey neutrals.
style.palette: Generated ramp palette, see src/assets/palette.ts; keep to the same hue families as the current asset.

background.notes: Transparent everywhere except the band; the band fades from about 45 percent alpha at the edge to 0 within roughly 12 px.

acceptanceCriteria: File is a PNG, exactly 128 x 128, 8-bit RGBA.
Composition, footprint and transparency class match the current map-shade-e-v1.png so the file is a drop-in replacement (same name at promotion).
Pixels are crisp: no anti-aliased edges, no smooth gradients; a 4x nearest-neighbour zoom shows only hard-edged pixels.
No text, signature, watermark, border or frame.
Only the east edge carries non-zero alpha; the opposite three edges are fully transparent.
Darkness and width comparable to the current band so rooms keep the same depth cue.
notes: Part of batch redo-starter-art-v1: a redo of every starter art asset. Recipe from src/assets/starter-art-inputs.ts: {"kind": "shade", "material": "shadow", "side": "e"}.
